plan.validation: Real recording, conditional refinement with published flight identities and coarse candidate; not a blind search.
plan.height_note: -30 m approximates a sea-level shoreline with geoid correction; 0 m is a datum sensitivity case. Camera height and weather are not measured.
plan.initial_calibration: At the common fixed coarse position, jointly sweep a shared +/-4 s clock shift and per-event +/-12 Hz source frequencies; no true location input.
